items.title: The pitch and the refusal
items.direction: Third flip through Guess not and instrumental: hold one two-shot. Captain makes his pitch; Harper calmly shakes her head. Replace the abrupt reaction and near-duplicate departure cuts. Dissolve into the food concourse.

items.title: Through the food concourse
items.direction: Harper threads left to right through a lively food concourse. Alien vendors, diners and passing travelers animate the space while she continues her search.

items.title: The parts and outfitters arcade
items.direction: Continue left to right through a distinct parts, travel-outfit and exotic-goods arcade. Keep movement purposeful and the aisle legible; no shopping detour.

items.title: An approving pause at the gantry
items.direction: At the gantry entrance Harper pauses, looks toward her ship and gives a small approving smile. Sphere and engine assembly are approximately 80 percent of prior physical size relative to Harper, with a human-sized entrance.

items.title: Cut closer as she boards
items.direction: Cut closer to the entry as Harper steps aboard. Omit the long wide approach; preserve the smaller ship scale and left-to-right travel. Settle inside by the next vocal.
